The local recharge and actual evapotranspiration of the InVEST Seasonal Water Yield model, routing the recharge available to the downslope cells along the flowdirections.

**Toolbox folder:** Hydro-Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Experimental<br>
**Keywords:** recharge<br>
**Authors:** The klab team.<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.SWYRechargeRouting`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inPet` | raster file | mm |  | The map of the potential evapotranspiration of the interval (single interval mode). |
| `inPrecipitation` | raster file | mm |  | The map of the precipitation of the interval (single interval mode). |
| `inFlowdirections` | raster file |  |  | The map of flowdirections (D8). |
| `inNet` | raster file |  |  | DEPRECATED, not needed and ignored: as in InVEST, stream cells follow the same water balance as the other cells. |
| `inQuickflow` | raster file | mm |  | The map of the quickflow of the interval (single interval mode). |
| `pAlpha` | double |  | `1.0` | The fraction of the upslope subsidy that is available in the interval (single interval mode). |
| `pBeta` | double |  | `1.0` | Spatial availability parameter: the fraction of the upgradient subsidy that is available for downgradient evapotranspiration, it is based on local topography and geology |
| `pGamma` | double |  | `1.0` | Fraction of pixel recharge that is available to downgradient pixels, represents what extent local recharge enters a local groundwater system and might be used again as oppose to entering a deeper groundwater system |
| `inPetFolder` | folder |  |  | The folder with the potential evapotranspiration of each interval (ex. the 12 months of a year), named as the pet prefix followed by the number of the interval. If set, the recharge is calculated over the whole period, as in InVEST, and the single interval inputs are not used. |
| `pPetPrefix` | String |  |  | The name prefix of the potential evapotranspiration rasters (ex. pet_ for pet_1.tif ... pet_12.tif). |
| `inPrecipitationFolder` | folder |  |  | The folder with the precipitation of each interval, used together with the pet folder. |
| `pPrecipitationPrefix` | String |  |  | The name prefix of the precipitation rasters (ex. prcp_ for prcp_1.tif ... prcp_12.tif). |
| `inQuickflowFolder` | folder |  |  | The folder with the quickflow of each interval, used together with the pet folder. |
| `pQuickflowPrefix` | String |  |  | The name prefix of the quickflow rasters (ex. qf_ for qf_1.tif ... qf_12.tif). |
| `pAlphas` | String |  |  | The comma separated fractions of the upslope subsidy available in each interval, in the order of the interval numbers, used together with the pet folder (if not set, 1/number of intervals, i.e. 1/12 for months as in InVEST). |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outAet` | output file | mm | The map of the actual evapotranspiration. |
| `outRecharge` | output file | mm | The map of the local recharge (L), what is left of the precipitation after quickflow and actual evapotranspiration. |
| `outUpslopeSubsidy` | output file | mm | The map of the upslope subsidy (the recharge available from upstream cells, L_sum_avail). |
| `outAvailableRecharge` | output file | mm | The map of the part of the local recharge that is available to downslope cells (L_avail = min(gamma * L, L)). |

**References**

- Natural Capital Project. InVEST User's Guide, Seasonal Water Yield. Stanford University, University of Minnesota, Chinese Academy of Sciences, The Nature Conservancy, World Wildlife Fund, Stockholm Resilience Centre and the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences. https://releases.naturalcapitalproject.org/invest-userguide/latest/
